item.title: A frigid day with warmer weather in out sight
item.description: Temperatures tried to warm back up yesterday, but our atmosphere's efforts all came crashing down following another cold front late in the day. item.title: Hawley pushes plan to eliminate taxes on healthcare
item.description: Missouri U.S. Sen. Josh Hawley is introducing a bill called the "No Taxes on Healthcare Act," which aims to eliminate taxes on a wide range of healthcare costs.

item.title: City Utilities announces next phases of Lead and Copper Rule water line identification project
item.description: City Utilities (CU) is in the process of identifying all privately-owned service lines in homes built before 1989 to comply with the EPA's Revised Lead and Copper Rule, and is asking customers to complete an online self-inspection as soon as possible.

item.description: HALFWAY, Mo. — A Polk County resident has filed a petition against the village of Halfway and its clerk, alleging they repeatedly violated Missouri’s Sunshine Law — a state transparency law that guarantees public access to government meetings and records except in narrowly defined circumstances. item.title: Shredded cheese sold in Missouri and 30 other states recalled due to metal fragments
item.description: The Food and Drug Administration is warning consumers to double-check their shredded cheese after an Ohio-based company recalled multiple products distributed to 31 states for having metal fragments.
